title: Tomato Blade
description: When you name a sword "Tomato Blade", it makes it a tomato sword
body: It's a Resource Pack, where when you name a **Netherite Sword** "Tomato Blade", it makes it look like a Tomato Sword. I use it on my Youtube Channel, which is also called **Tomatofacex1**. This is also my first resource pack.
